sentences.en: I usually hit the snooze button a couple of times before getting up.
sentences.ko: 일어나기 전에 보통 스누즈 버튼을 두어 번 누르는 편이에요.

sentences.en: I always lay out my clothes the night before to save time in the morning.
sentences.ko: 아침에 시간을 아끼려고 항상 전날 밤에 옷을 미리 꺼내 놓아요.

sentences.en: I always make sure to eat a proper breakfast before I leave the house.
sentences.ko: 집을 나서기 전에 항상 제대로 된 아침 식사를 챙겨 먹어요.

sentences.en: Could you brief me on what was discussed before I joined?
sentences.ko: 제가 합류하기 전에 논의된 내용을 간략히 설명해 주시겠어요?

sentences.en: Let's run through the agenda quickly before we get started.
